claim_text: Some parts of Indiana received more than 11 inches of rainfall over three days beginning 11 August 2026, causing record floods and putting several suburbs of Indianapolis underwater, NPR reported on 16 August 2026.
quote: Some parts of Indiana received more than 11 inches of rainfall over three days, beginning Aug. 11, causing record floods. Several suburbs of Indianapolis also underwater.
confidence_justification: Rainfall total matches the National Weather Service figure cited elsewhere in the cluster, but this summary gives a three-day window where other reports say two days.
